name: Community — MiniMax H3 (LMS Sharpen)
author: Alissonerdx + alibaba-pai + Jalen-Brunson
description: Sharpen a finished MiniMax H3 clip at its own size with Alissonerdx's LMS LoRA (rank 64, Apache-2.0), used the way it was trained: the whole source clip goes in as an aligned latent guide through ComfyUI's native Add Guide at frame 0, and the model re-renders it from the guide with the LoRA's own caption. Not an upscaler (that is the Video Refine pack): output is the tier you pick (480p default, up to 608p), the source scaled to it; the aligned guide doubles the sequence length so 768p does not fit on 12 GB. MEASURED 2026-09-10 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, engine ComfyUI 0.34.2: a 5 s 864x480 clip in 253 s. Same seed, same clip, guide only (LoRA off) vs guide + LoRA: native-pixel crop sharpness 712 -> 789 (+11%; source clip 683), whole-frame 808 vs 797, PSNR to the source 29.0 -> 23.7 dB (the LoRA changes more than the plain guide pass), luma a touch darker (103 -> 98). Rope, rust and barnacle detail visibly cleaner; composition, motion and audio untouched. Best on H3 clips that came out a little soft; a 4-5 minute pass per 5 s at 480p.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 LMS Sharpen
presets.tagline: Sharpen an H3 clip - guide-latent LoRA, pick the output tier, source audio kept
presets.description: Drop a finished H3 clip in Reference Video 1. The prompt is optional (the LoRA's caption is prepended for you); add a short note only if the clip needs steering. Output = the clip at its own size, re-rendered from an aligned guide latent with the LMS sharpening LoRA at 1.0 and Alibaba's PDD 8-step at full denoise, source audio passed through. MEASURED 2026-09-10 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, engine ComfyUI 0.34.2: a 5 s 864x480 clip in 253 s. Same seed, same clip, guide only (LoRA off) vs guide + LoRA: native-pixel crop sharpness 712 -> 789 (+11%; source clip 683), whole-frame 808 vs 797, PSNR to the source 29.0 -> 23.7 dB (the LoRA changes more than the plain guide pass), luma a touch darker (103 -> 98). Rope, rust and barnacle detail visibly cleaner; composition, motion and audio untouched. OUTPUT SIZE: pick the tier; the source is scaled (centre-crop) to it, so match the aspect ratio of your clip. The aligned guide doubles the token count versus a normal render, so 480p is the safe tier on 12 GB and 768p sources must come DOWN to 480p/544p (a 1344x768 source at its own size runs out of memory on a 4070 Ti, 2026-09-10). Duration follows the clip (trimmed to 15 s, snapped to the 17k+5 frame grid). Pick Video Refine instead when you want a higher tier; this pass does not change the size.

video.displayModel: MiniMax H3 Reference (pruned int8) + LMS sharpen LoRA + Alibaba PDD Acc

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed by SimpliGen.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-PDD-Acc
extensions.description: Loads Alibaba's official PDD acceleration LoRA (trunk + parallel-decoding head bank + trained sigma schedule with partial denoise). NOT pre-installed by SimpliGen.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
extensions.description: Provides PathchSageAttentionKJ for SimpliGen's Faster Attention injection (supportsSage). Not used by the graph itself.

requirements.notes: Official ref2va pruned int8 checkpoint, encoder, VAEs and the PDD Acc Ref2VA LoRA are shared with the Video Refine and PDD packs; the only new download is the 1.2 GB LMS LoRA (Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI on Hugging Face, Apache-2.0). The aligned guide doubles the sequence length, so the output tier is capped at 608p and 480p is the 12 GB default; a 768p source is scaled down to the tier. Sharpening, not upscaling: run this BEFORE Video Refine if you want both. LICENCE: derivative of MiniMax H3, MiniMax H3 Community License applies.
